decisions.statement: An environment override names the whole path rather than the folder.
An override that is empty text is no override.
A file lands readable and writable by its owner alone.
A missing file reads as nothing.
A file that will not parse reads as nothing.
A file the shape refuses reads as nothing.
Reading nothing where a file is unreadable is said on the error stream.
Removing a file that is already gone is done.
Nothing here knows the values a Spotify file has.

definition: a small JSON file kept for Spotify in the user's cache folder
